crossRefs.note: After these days Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,

people.name: Elizabeth
people.line: The wife of Zechariah and mother of John the Baptist.

translations.web: Behold, Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.
translations.bsb: Look, even Elizabeth your relative has conceived a son in her old age, and she who was called barren is in her sixth month.
translations.kjv: And, behold, thy cousin Elisabeth, she hath also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren.
translations.asv: And behold, Elisabeth thy kinswoman, she also hath conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her that was called barren.
